defaultGrantCount.label: Default /siphon give Count
defaultGrantCount.description: Number of empty Orbs of Siphoning granted by '/siphon give' when no explicit count is provided.

allowCrossSlotReplacement.label: Allow Cross-Slot Replacement When Capacity Permits
allowCrossSlotReplacement.description: When true, a stored Prefix may replace a Suffix (or vice versa) if the target item still stays within its Prefix/Suffix caps.

preserveExactRolledValues.label: Preserve Exact Rolled Values
preserveExactRolledValues.description: Keep the exact integer stat values stolen from the source item when imbuing the target item.

enableNaturalDrops.label: Enable Natural World Drops
enableNaturalDrops.description: When true, Empty Orbs of Siphoning enter LocalExile's natural currency drop pool via DropPoolOverlays.

dropWeight.label: Natural Drop Weight
dropWeight.description: Relative currency pool weight for Empty Orbs of Siphoning (higher drops more frequently).

minAreaLevel.label: Minimum Area Level
minAreaLevel.description: Minimum area or monster level required for Empty Orbs of Siphoning to drop naturally.

maxAreaLevel.label: Maximum Area Level (0 = Unbounded)
maxAreaLevel.description: Optional inclusive maximum area or monster level for natural drops; 0 imposes no upper bound.

sources.label: Natural Drop Sources
sources.description: World drop sources eligible to roll Empty Orbs of Siphoning.

monsterRarity.label: Eligible Monster Rarities
monsterRarity.description: Monster rarities and boss archetypes eligible to drop Empty Orbs of Siphoning.
